name: systole
description: Systole — a single-file cardiology board-review app built from a personal ACCSAP 12 export. The question bank itself is licensed content and is never committed.

scripts.pwa: node scripts/extract-content.js build/systole.html && node scripts/build-pwa.js build/systole.html

comments.dependencies: The BUILD has none on purpose — it is Node's standard library and the scripts in scripts/, and `npm run build` needs no install at all. devDependencies are for the TESTS only: playwright drives the suites, ts-fsrs regenerates tests/fixtures/fsrs-oracle.json and is otherwise unused (the fixture itself is committed, so verify-oracle runs without it). Both are pinned to exact versions rather than ranges, and package-lock.json pins their transitive tree, because a suite that measures a browser is measuring a specific browser.
comments.usage: npm test runs every check that needs no export (the suites CI runs). With your export: npm run build -- path/to/ACCSAP_export.html   then   npm run test:private
comments.browsers: Playwright downloads its own browsers on install. Set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH to share one copy, and PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 where they are already provisioned. `npx playwright install chromium webkit` is the minimum for a full run; CI's memorizer-browser job also runs Firefox, so install `firefox` too to reproduce it locally (it is also what --engine firefox needs).
